title: Great tour
text: Perfect pace, great knowledgeable guide. Included the cathedral and Arabic baths. Definitely worth doing would recommend
author: markiemarc

title: Jaen, a big surprise!
text: A fantastic tour and David, the tour guide, was great, very friendly and made us have a great time and enjoy Jaén. Highly recommended.
author: 865violetas

title: Discover Jaen title
text: A very informative and enjoyable tour . Our guide was excellent and would definitely recommend if your in Jaen for a short period of time .
author: Steve W

title: Brilliant
text: Amazing! Our guide, David, was friendly and enthusiastic and really took the time to explain and ask and answer questions. We ended up going back to several sites later, but this was invaluable in finding our way around a stunning town.
author: Laura_C

title: Jaen was beautiful
text: David was fabulous. Polite, patient, informative. Tour was great. I would never have known what Jaen offered without the tour.
author: Mary_L

title: Well worth it
text: Excellence tour our guide Ana Belen was amazing and made the tour extremely interesting and light hearted. She provided the right amount of information and not an overload of historical facts. Highly recommended
author: John_C

title: Enjoyable tour
text: Very enjoyable tour with Patricia who was full of fun facts about the City. We’ll worth doing if you are in Jaen
author: APGBrit

title: Excellent tour
text:
All of it ! 
What a brilliant couple of hours . The guide ( unfortunately I can't remember her name ) , was excellent , she was very knowledgeable , funny and took time to answer and explain any questions we had . It was only her fifth tour , but she is made for the job . 
Highly recommend tours by this company .
author: GarethD66

title: Essential
text: As a former guide I always look for tour companies when I travel because it seems the best and fastest way to get to know the cities. In this case we did a paid tour with Helena and say she is an excellent guide. A very laughing girl who conveys that joy in her explanations. Also, and just as importantly, you know the history of your city so the tour perfectly meets expectations. I recommend it.
author: antonioo151

title: Outstanding
text: Helena gave us a very entertaining guided tour, full of interesting anecdotes and stories. Time flew by and everything was super well explained. As an added bonus that is very appreciated, he offered to take pictures and recommended other visits around the province. Unbeatable.
author: irissofi
